{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patient_id values and total rows
print(f"Total rows: {len(df)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Duplicate patient_id occurrences: {df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()}")

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient_id
sample_seq_summary = df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts()
print(f"Highest sample_seq per patient_id: \n{sample_seq_summary}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
count_neg999 = (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {count_neg999}")

# Check assay_batch values and their impact on biomarker_final
print(f"Assay_batch values: {df['assay_batch'].unique()}")

# Check if biomarker_final has values that need scaling (batch B needs /10)
batch_b_values = df[df['assay_batch'] == 'B']['biomarker_final'].describe()
print(f"Batch B biomarker_final stats: \n{batch_b_values}")"}
